# Verify user identity

## Summary

Confirm who's signing in to your n8n instance, from two-factor auth to directory-backed single sign-on.

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/administer/manage-users-and-access/verify-user-identity.md

---

Confirm who's signing in to your n8n instance, from two-factor auth to directory-backed single sign-on.

In n8n, go to **Settings** > **Authentication** to see the sign-in methods for your instance. The page lists single sign-on (SSO) and LDAP, marks the active method, and shows whether two-factor auth is enforced.

## In this section

* [Require two-factor auth](/administer/manage-users-and-access/verify-user-identity/require-two-factor-auth): enable 2FA for your n8n account.
* [Connect LDAP](/administer/manage-users-and-access/verify-user-identity/connect-ldap): use LDAP with n8n.
* [Use SAML](/administer/manage-users-and-access/verify-user-identity/use-saml): enable SAML SSO (single sign-on) in n8n.
* [Use OIDC](/administer/manage-users-and-access/verify-user-identity/use-oidc): enable OpenID Connect (OIDC) for single sign-on.
